FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-001.says: As added: a grid of 20 pixels, three cells by two, each cut into two triangles thrown out from the middle and towards the eye, falling and spinning; frame 0 the layer as it is.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-002.says: A close look: a grid of 8 pixels, 48 triangles; frame 3 just cracked apart, frame 12 flying.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-003.says: Object Polygon: each triangle its own flat colour.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-004.says: Object Textured Square: squares carrying the picture.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-005.says: Object Square: squares, each its own flat colour.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-006.says: Force 0: the shards only fall and spin.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-007.says: Gravity 0, Force 100: thrown out slowly, not falling.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-009.says: Spinning 0: the shards fly flat, facing the eye.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-011.says: The force centre at the top left corner: thrown down and right.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-012.says: Direction Randomness 0: each thrown straight out from the centre, 45 degrees towards the eye.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-013.says: Direction Randomness 100: thrown every which way, from flat across the layer to straight at the eye.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-014.says: Speed Randomness 100: speeds from none to full.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-015.says: Depth Sort off: drawn in grid order, later shards over earlier ones whatever their depth.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-016.says: Start Time 0.5 seconds: frame 6 the layer as it is, frame 18 FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-002's frame 6.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-017.says: The picture with its right half clear: the right half's shards are clear.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-018.says: The half picture, Object Polygon: the right half's triangles clear, the left half's flat.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-019.says: A grid of 7 pixels, which fits neither side: the last column and row of cells cut at the layer's edge.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-020.says: Force keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 600 at frame 24: frame 12 is Force 300 at frame 12, the whole flight from the key's value then.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-021.says: FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-022.says: FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-002 with the layer starting at frame 6: frame 9 is 002's frame 3 and frame 18 its 12.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-023.says: Through a composition camera 100 pixels away over the middle: the shards coming at the eye grow less than through the effect's own eye 67 pixels away.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-024.says: The composition camera 6 pixels to the right: the frame moved 6 pixels left, the shards seen from the side.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-025.says: FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-002 at 30 frames a second: frame 12 is two fifths of a second in, not half.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-026.says: Force -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-027.says: Gravity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-028.says: Spinning 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-029.says: Force Center X 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-030.says: Direction Randomness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-031.says: Speed Randomness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POLYGON-SHARDS-032.says: Grid Spacing 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
